name: tone-radar
description: See the tone of every sentence before you hit send. Powered by TypeSafe Jev.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client -- --watchAll=false
